pretraining_provenance: YOLO11 COCO Feature Representation + Urban Street Adaptation

spatial_validation_strategy.method: Spatial Group-K-Fold by Street (Strict Leakage Prevention)

prototype_limitations_and_production_roa.scientific_honesty_statement: The model is explicitly designated as a PROTOTYPE. A deep neural network cannot achieve true enterprise generalization solely from 108 localized Coimbatore street frames.
verified_achievements: Successfully prevented spatial data leakage across street corridors
Demonstrated strong transfer learning convergence on buildings, poles, luminaires, and commercial signs
Established reproducible pipeline linking Public Training Data (Mapillary/Cityscapes) to local Coimbatore validation
production_scaling_path: Integrate full 25,000 Mapillary Vistas street panorama segmentations
Incorporate HOTOSM Street-level Poles (3,500 images) and Chennai Streetlight dataset
Deploy multi-view triangulation for geographic asset feature aggregation
